message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
# pad poc1 to 8192, update phdr sizes? Current PT_LOAD filesz says 488 causing check file_size? It can be larger than segment maybe dynamic within, ok but check_pt_load file_size >= offend. Better set p_filesz/memsz to 8192 and maybe dynamic unchanged.
import struct
buf=bytearray(open('poc1.bin','rb').read())
new=8192
buf += b'\0'*(new-len(buf))
# update ELF phdr load filesz memsz at offset phoff 52: fields p_filesz at +16, p_memsz +20
struct.pack_into('<II', buf, 52+16, new, new)
open('poc2.bin','wb').write(buf)
print(len(buf))
PY
bash submit.sh /workspace/poc2.bin /workspace/analysis.json
